In July 2026, he said America must win the AI race without asking working families to pay for it.

summary_sentences.text: In September 2026, Loeffler credited AI with supporting new companies and helping American industry hire and compete.
In June 2026, she described AI as improving small-business productivity and helping small firms compete with larger businesses.

In July 2026, she linked AI to easier business formation and growth and said the administration’s Ratepayer Protection Pledge would allow Americans to benefit from U.S. AI dominance without higher utility costs.
